Position Summary 		   Total Duration 27   working  days
Note: Payment shall only   be  made after submission   of  a report   and  relevant deliverables   for  each milestone,   to  be reviewed   and  approved by   the  National Malaria Program.
Objective   and  Justification
The primary objective   of  hiring   a  Technical Assistant (TA)   is  to develop   and  implement role-based MIS dashboards that   provide  relevant, timely,   and  actionable information   to  authorized users across different health programs   and  management levels.
The specific objectives   are  to:
• Assess dashboard   and  information requirements   for  different user   roles  and management levels.
• Define priority indicators,   data  sources, calculations,   and  visualization requirements.
• Design   and  develop user-friendly, interactive, role-based dashboards.
• Integrate dashboards   with  harmonized common master   data  and relevant MIS modules.
• Implement appropriate role-, program-, administrative-,   and  facility-based access controls.
• Support   data  quality validation, dashboard performance, testing,   and  user acceptance.
Scope   of  Work
The selected TA   will  work closely   with  the Head   of  the MIS Unit, relevant CNM teams,   program  managers,   data  users, developers,   and  technical counterparts.   The  TA   will  assess information needs,   design  dashboard prototypes, develop   and  integrate dashboards, validate indicators   and  data,   and  support implementation.
Duties & Responsibilities:
•  Assessment   and  Dashboard Planning
•  Review   existing  MIS reports, dashboards, indicators,   and  analytical requirements.
•  Identify major user groups   and  their information needs.
•  Define priority indicators,   data  sources, calculation rules,   and  reporting dimensions.
•  Develop   a  dashboard requirements matrix covering user roles, programs, administrative levels,   and  access requirements.
•  Develop   a  detailed dashboard implementation plan.
•  Dashboard   Design  and Prototyping
•  Develop dashboard layouts   and  prototypes   for  relevant user groups.
•  Design appropriate charts, tables, maps, trends, comparisons,   and  status indicators.
•  Design navigation   and  drill-down   from  summary information   to  relevant detailed information.
•  Ensure dashboards   are  clear, intuitive, responsive,   and  suitable   for  management decision-making.
•  Validate prototypes   with  relevant users before final development.
•  Role-Based Dashboard   Development  and Integration
•  Develop dashboards   for  national, program, provincial/subnational, district,   and  facility/operational users   as  required.
•  Implement role-based, program-based, geographic,   and  facility-based   data  access.
•  Integrate dashboard indicators   with  common MIS master   data  and relevant modules.
•  Integrate information   from  e-training, alerts, stock management,   and  other approved   data  sources where appropriate.
•  Support filtering by period, program, administrative area, facility,   and  other relevant dimensions.
•  Implement drill-down   and  export functionality where required.
•  Data Validation, Testing   and  Performance
•  Validate indicator definitions, calculations,   and  dashboard outputs against source data.
•  Identify   and  address   data  quality issues affecting dashboard results.
•  Conduct functional,   data  accuracy, access control,   and  performance testing.
•  Support user acceptance testing   and  incorporate agreed feedback.
•  Optimize queries   and  dashboard   performance  for increasing   data  volumes.
•  Documentation   and  Capacity Building
•  Document indicator definitions,   data  sources, calculation methodologies,   and  access rules.
•  Develop user guidance   and  technical documentation.
•  Provide recommendations   for  dashboard maintenance   and  future expansion.
•  Provide knowledge transfer   to  relevant CNM   and  MIS/IT staff.
•  Expected Outputs
•  Dashboard requirements matrix covering users, indicators,   data  sources,   and  access requirements.
•  Dashboard designs   and  prototypes validated   with  relevant stakeholders.
•  Role-based dashboards developed   and  integrated   with  common MIS   data  and relevant modules.
•  Role-based access controls   and  appropriate filtering implemented.
•  Dashboard indicators   and  calculations validated against source data.
•  Tested   and  refined dashboards deployed   or  prepared   for  deployment.
•  Technical   and  user documentation   and  knowledge transfer provided.
